decisions.reason: The aloe vera line is the most visibly committed product, with its own page in both years and investment in a whole line, so management is inclined to persist with it as part of its announced innovation direction.

The hyaluronic serum has stayed on the website for two years and fits the core facial care range, so withdrawing it would mean admitting an earlier development decision was wrong, and any weak results can still be put down to market build-up.
The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024 and likely replaces the withdrawn cleansing milk, so the firm has just recommitted to this category and would treat early disappointments as temporary.
